label: Systematic review
definition: A structured search that gathers and appraises all studies on a question — the top of the evidence pyramid.

label: Meta-analysis
definition: Statistically pools the results of many studies into one combined estimate.

label: Clinical practice guideline
definition: Formal recommendations from an expert body that synthesize the evidence for clinicians.

label: Randomized controlled trial
definition: People are randomly assigned to treatment vs control — the strongest single-study test of cause and effect.

label: Non-randomized / controlled trial
definition: An interventional trial without randomization (or a controlled clinical trial); weaker than an RCT.

label: Prospective cohort study
definition: Follows groups over time to see who develops outcomes; strong observational design.

label: Case-control study
definition: Compares people with and without an outcome looking back at exposures.

label: Cross-sectional / other observational
definition: A snapshot in time or other observational study without a comparison over time.

label: Case series
definition: A description of several similar patients with no control group.

label: Case report
definition: A description of a single patient — useful for signals but not proof.

label: Narrative review / expert opinion
definition: A non-systematic overview or opinion; useful for context but subjective.

label: Preclinical — animal (in vivo)
definition: Done in living animals — an early step before human evidence.

label: In vitro / mechanistic
definition: Done in cells or a test tube outside a living body — the earliest kind of evidence.

label: Other / unclear
definition: Design not determined from the available information.
